abstract.content: This fictional study examines how inconsistent star ratings across review platforms affect reader trust. Inconsistent ratings reduced trust and increased decision effort. The text is invented test data for the paper page.

value.research_question: 線上評價平台上，不同來源的星等彼此不一致時，讀者對商家的信任會不會下降。

value.theory: 訊號理論與認知負荷理論。
value.findings: 星等不一致時信任明顯下降，受測者也需要更多時間判斷。
